value.intent: Static transparent asymmetric success check coherent with the existing cool-blue queue family; no fixed palette.

intake.rationale: Concrete candidate interpretation for the reviewed scope; source requirements retain their original authority in the selected PLAR and packet.

requirements.name: geometry
requirements.check: Delivered PNG decodes as exactly 16x16 and one static frame.
requirements.reason: PNG 16x16 one static frame; asset-check exact bytes passes.

requirements.name: transparency
requirements.check: Background is transparent without an unintended opaque canvas matte; intentional subject components are judged visually, and partial alpha is permitted.
requirements.reason: Viewed exterior clear on transparent and dark background; white circular interior is intentional success badge subject, not a canvas matte.

requirements.name: success
requirements.check: Ready visibly reads as a check mark with asymmetrical arms conveying successful completion. No particular unequal-length recipe is mandatory.
requirements.reason: Visible blue tick bends from shorter descending arm into ascending arm; asymmetrical relationship reads successful completion at both sizes.

requirements.name: readability
requirements.check: Silhouette and deliberate pixel clusters/edges remain readable at 1x and 3x nearest on #172336.
requirements.reason: Native symbol reads as success badge/check; 3x shows deliberate stepped border and tick clusters without blur.

requirements.name: style
requirements.check: Ready uses a perceptible cool blue accent and coheres with the uploaded adopted Ready style reference and existing queue siblings; no fixed palette, exact hex, stroke width or margin is required.
requirements.reason: Cyan/blue stepped edges and modest shading cohere with reference and queue context; white subject backing increases completion emphasis without eliminating blue accent. No exact palette/footprint rule applied.

requirements.name: distinction
requirements.check: In both actual consumers at 1x and 3x, Ready is distinguishable from Working/activity, Retry and Paused without relying on color, including grayscale; collective appearance remains coherent.
requirements.reason: Actual full and compact destination color/grayscale views distinguish completed check badge from open activity arc, retry arrow and paired pause bars. Coherent cool-blue stepped rendering is preserved; white success emphasis is a permitted family variation.

requirements.name: consumer
requirements.check: Actual bounded renderer exercises statusCell and compactStatus, showing Ready for successful completion at its existing destination with expected 1x/3x nearest display and alpha behavior.
requirements.reason: Both actual consumers show Ready for succeeded after ok, using assets/ready-confirmed.png exact generated bytes; 1x/3x nearest and alpha composition verified in full check, with actual cells inspected.

requirements.name: production
requirements.check: Ready lineage is established by actual official PixelLab submission, returned identity and exact downloaded-byte provenance, with all failures retained; reference fixture origin remains distinct.
requirements.reason: One actual official Pro Flash call produced job55f61beb-7f68-4cac-9ac3-3d1e0e91c791, completed image7450c9d6-b8c6-5e09-896c-83f8bef86c12; exact downloaded443-byte PNG SHA f8479c778690fd0b128bf15dfa9b88b80d5237ae1c421f8ed143176275c68c2f was imported without editing. Fixture remains style reference only.

requirements.name: preservation
requirements.check: Only assigned Ready destination and production-plar progress may change outside fresh work/store; original brief, source, Start, Working, Retry, Paused, original plar and historical receipts remain unchanged.
requirements.reason: All protected baseline file hashes match, including original plar, sources, siblings, Start and original Ready snapshot. Only Ready destination and production queue progress changed outside assigned fresh-work/store locations.
